The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 fb3f3a7a4115f5ec), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. statement: Suppose F ∈ Dlcc(B, E) is a coherent Hecke eigencomplex for a continuous parameter σ : πet 1 (U) → Ǧ(L) with Zariski-dense image, where L/Qℓ is finite. Then every pHj(F) has a natural coherent eigenstructure for σ, with singular support in Λ. The eigenmaps are natural in representations and compatible with the unit, convolution, permutations, and fusion on every collision diagonal. If F ̸= 0, some pHj(F) is nonzero. No global cohomological bound on F and no condition on the boundary monodromy are required.
